symptom: Agent starts keep a stale shell PATH after new CLI installation or a failed cold-boot probe, even after the shell profile can provide a working toolchain.
rule: Re-probe the real cache and retry at most once after a typed executable-not-found start. Preserve explicit PATH additions, retain the last confirmed snapshot, fence cancelled executions across owner changes, and never retry a prompt or a process that may already have run (principles 1, 4, 7 and 13).
